implemented: Signed track_published dispatch requires current instance-to-server binding and exact VIDEO/SCREEN_SHARE track. Windows/web primary publisher identity and native _ss identity are both supported; the earlier _ss-only implementation was insufficient for the requested desktop/web scope.

Verifier uses the real LiveKit SDK to query current main/share participants and exact publication SID, matching voice membership and current uncached actor ViewChannel/ConnectVoice/Stream permissions, timeout and ban status. Client is_streaming alone is not authority.

A bounded 15-second notification pass rechecks the provider before each recipient. Durable publication decisions are excluded from subsequent retry candidates so partial runs advance instead of starving later recipients.

SQLite/PostgreSQL delivery transaction rechecks explicit actor consent, recipient preference, active accounts/platform bans, accepted friendship, blocks, current membership, voice channel identity, actor ViewChannel/ConnectVoice/Stream and current server bans/timeouts, and recipient ViewChannel. Servers above 200 members are excluded both when listing and committing.

PostgreSQL delivery uses ordered per-account FOR SHARE NOWAIT row guards and SHARE MODE NOWAIT guards on nine authorization/lifecycle/moderation tables. Conflicting writes fail the attempt and roll back its decision so webhook retry can re-evaluate current eligibility, instead of waiting while holding partial table locks.

Fresh authorized publications not yet visible in the provider return a retryable error/503 without consuming a delivery decision. Signed creation time is bounded to two minutes old / 30 seconds future skew and independently checked throughout fanout; expired/invalid events are acknowledged without notification work.

Per-publication/recipient decisions prevent duplicate callbacks, opt-out replay and recreation after deleting a notice. Opaque notification IDs and payload action stream_start omit room/channel/track metadata.
Only committed notifications are broadcast. EN/TR inbox and desktop/sound/taskbar cues respect preference, DND/invisible, focus and duplicate delivery.
Account cleanup removes retained decision rows even without FK enforcement; personal export includes only the requester's recipient decision history, not other users' delivery decisions.
